Complete specification for /distill --learn sub-mode (retroactive batch harvest of unharvested memory_candidates across already-archived tasks, written to hosted knowledge objects via sapience-remember.sh under a per-task write bound, distinguished from /learn --task N and /todo's archive-time harvest) -- extracted from skill-distill/SKILL.md per the mode-gated section loading convention

Complete specification for /distill --revise sub-mode (event-and-OTel-correlated review of hosted knowledge objects: Event Clustering, three-strikes threshold, Hosted-Store Correlation via sapience-retrieve.sh with a mandatory reachability probe, SUPERSEDE/SKIP gate via sapience-remember.sh) -- extracted from skill-distill/SKILL.md per the mode-gated section loading convention

Complete specification for /distill --refine sub-mode (two-tier memory metadata quality improvement: Tier 1 safe automatic fixes, Tier 2 interactive AskUserQuestion-gated improvements) -- extracted from skill-distill/SKILL.md per the mode-gated section loading convention

Complete specification for /distill --compress sub-mode (reduce oversized memories to key points, preserving originals in a History section and verifying keyword preservation) -- extracted from skill-distill/SKILL.md per the mode-gated section loading convention

Complete specification for /distill --merge sub-mode (pairwise duplicate detection within topic clusters, keyword-superset-guaranteed content merge, tombstone the absorbed secondary, cross-reference update, index regeneration) -- extracted from skill-distill/SKILL.md per the mode-gated section loading convention

Complete specification for /distill --purge sub-mode (identify stale/zero-retrieval memories, tombstone via frontmatter mutation rather than deletion; Link-Scan/Retrieval-Exclusion/health-report infrastructure is shared with gc and stays in skill-distill/SKILL.md) -- extracted from skill-distill/SKILL.md per the mode-gated section loading convention
